events.note: Authored for credential-evidence#246 (E2) from the cited provider pages; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#246, on the owner's instruction of 2026-10-05 to take maintainer-only decisions for this work. Question: the part after /token: in an email-address-and-token Basic credential string is a credential whatever its shape? Options: require a documented prefix, alphabet or width (Zendesk states none) or flag only one recognised shape; or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag the token part only, leaving the email address and the separator outside the span; no shape inferred. Reason: The provider pages document the composition and call the token a password, not its value format, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The provider pages document the composition but no token format, so a marker-only rule can flag non-secrets or miss a token written without the marker, and the email address may or may not be confidential.
events.reversingEvidence: A Zendesk statement of the token format or of the confidentiality of the email address that contradicts this outcome, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
